purpose: Teach: 彗星/五感/血統/農作物/和音/帰結/筋力/教祖

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、彗星イベント会場の警備を、警察、担当されますね
lines.en: So the police will be handling security at the comet event venue, then?
lines.style: Curious, measured questioning. Soft emphasis on the procedural detail. Seeking confirmation without pushing. Respectful distance maintained in the voice.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、被害者の五感証言も丁寧に聴取します
lines.en: The police will be taking detailed witness statements from the victims across all their accounts.
lines.style: Steady, professional clarification. Matter-of-fact delivery, each point land cleanly. Calm authority without coldness. Informative tone.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、血統詐欺事件を、警察、扱われてますね
lines.en: And the police are also investigating this blood-type fraud case, I understand?
lines.style: Thoughtful pause before speaking. Gentle probing. Acknowledging the complexity. Voice carries respect for the investigative process.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、農作物窃盗事件にも対応します
lines.en: The police are responding to the crop theft cases as well.
lines.style: Factual statement delivered with steady confidence. No inflection wasted. Clear and direct. The tone of someone stating what will happen.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、楽器の和音が事件の鍵だったって、警察、興味深いですね
lines.en: It's interesting that the musical chord turned out to be a key piece of evidence in this case, isn't it?
lines.style: Genuine intrigue in the opening. Slight rise of fascination mid-sentence. Thoughtful, almost marveling. Acknowledges the unusual elegance of the connection.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、事件の帰結を市民に丁寧に報告します
lines.en: The police are committed to reporting the case outcomes to the community in a thorough and transparent way.
lines.style: Formal but warm undertone. Clear commitment in the delivery. Each clause weighted evenly. The assurance of accountability without defensiveness.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、容疑者の筋力からの推定も、警察、おこなわれますね
lines.en: Even the estimates based on the suspect's physical strength will be part of the police investigation, I take it?
lines.style: Curious about the technical depth. Respectful hesitation before the question lands. Interest in how thoroughly the case is being worked. Thoughtful pace.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、新興宗教教祖の不正に厳しく対応します
lines.en: The police will be taking a firm stance against the corruption and misconduct of this cult leader.
lines.style: Steelier resolve entering the voice. Conviction hardens slightly on 'firm.' Less room for ambiguity here. The edge of someone serious about accountability.
